EmailTemplate.name: SPA Invitation Email
EmailTemplate.subject: Invitation to Finalise Your Al Naseem Community Sales & Purchase Agreement
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Account.Name},
We are pleased to inform you that your Al Naseem Community property purchase with Modon is almost complete. As a valued customer, we are preparing your Sales & Purchase Agreement (SPA), and we would like to invite you to our Sales center to finalise the process in preparation for signing your documents.
Date: 11th – 15th June 2024
Time: From 9am – 7pm
Venue: Modon Sales Centre, Hudayriyat Island, Abu Dhabi
This is an exciting step towards securing your new home, and our team will be on hand to assist you through the process and answer any questions you might have.
During your visit, the following steps will need to be completed to issue your SPA:
1. Confirmation of your selected finishing colour scheme 2. Provision of a cheque for the 2% Abu Dhabi Municipality Fees; a bank transfer can also be accepted for this transaction (see bank details below) 3. Provision of post-dated checks for the payments due from September 2027, as per the project payment plan
Upon completing the steps above, your SPA will be issued for signature, after which your property will be registered with the Abu Dhabi Municipality.
To ensure a smooth experience during your visit, please bring the following documents:
- A valid passport copy and Emirates ID (UAE residents only) - Any outstanding documents related to your purchase. - Cheque book.
We look forward to welcoming you to our Sales Centre and assisting you in making your new home a reality.
Kind regards, Modon Sales Team
Please note that ADM fee payments can be made by bank transfer:
Account number: 4031005972963002 IBAN Number: AE610354031005972963002 Currency: AED Customer name: HUDAYRIYAT DEVELOPMENT LLC – ADM Customer address: Hudayriyat Island, Abu Dhabi Bank name: First Abu Dhabi Bank First Abu Dhabi Bank Swift Code: NBADAEAA
